title: Insufficient warm-up: SMA 5/20 on 9 bars never leaves warm-up
purpose: With fewer accepted bars than long_window nothing is computed and nothing is signalled; the tool warns instead of repairing.

provenance.derived_by: by hand, from the strategy document and the fixture bars; not copied from any run of the tool
sources: docs/strategies/moving_average_crossover.md section 4 (nothing is emitted until long_window bars)
derivation: long_window 20 needs 20 accepted bars; the dataset has 9 bars, so every event is warming_up (window fill 1..9 of 20)
no averages exist, so none can be compared and no signal is possible; the documented warning fewer_bars_than_warmup applies
cross_checks: tests/unit/strategy_lab_replay_test.cpp: LabReplayWarmup (the same rule at the boundary), explore test test_runner_warnings_are_shown
